about.title: About True Title Houston
text: True Title Partners of Lubbock opened its doors on October 1st, 2017. Created to be different, True Title is honored to be a part of the fabric of the Houston community. We view our services as a partnership with local real estate agents, builders, developers, and investors to close first-time home buyers to seasoned investors. Our office is your office. If you are in the area, please drop in, enjoy a drink or coffee on us, or utilize one of our conference rooms.
